name: West Al-Arqas Outpost
title: West Al-Arqas Outpost
summary: Old starter outpost west of Al-Arqas, destroyed by Martine (acpedia). In the kit: a 28 m Empyrean tower with green lamps and, 48 m east, a three-storey yellow-brick hall with a tapered dome roof, arcades and lanterns, the Life Stone and a vat, on the dunes.

site.name: West Al-Arqas Outpost
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer life-stone-near-al-arqas-8c58 (the outpost Life Stone, 27 m from the anchor).

shots.standingOrder: Hang 95 m south-south-west and 22 m up, drifting 12 degrees and easing in on the green-lit Empyrean tower and the domed arcaded hall on the dunes; nothing within 50 m, creatures may be faded.
shots.notes: Wide drifting establishing view of the ruined West Al-Arqas outpost: the 28 m Empyrean tower with its green lamps and the yellow-brick domed hall with arches and lanterns side by side on the dunes, low golden sun raking from the west.
